title: toggle() randomly skips the PATCH before refetching
summary: toggle() returns early about half the time (Math.random() < 0.5) before sending the PATCH, so a checkbox click is sometimes a no-op and the counter never drops to 0. The spec and the rest of the app are correct; the failure of "completing a task updates the counter and the Done filter" is nondeterministic with no relevant code change.
